description: Φρεάτια is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δήμος Παπάγου-Χολαργού. Φρεάτια από Έργο ομβρίων οδού Υγείας & Κύπρου. Coverage: Δήμος Παπάγου-Χολαργού. The publisher named on the listing is Δήμος Παπάγου-Χολαργού. Its keywords include γεωχωρικά, features, inspire, papagou-cholargou, gis. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, GEOJSON, CSV, SHAPE-ZIP. The listing shows 2026-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
